description: The JSON of the `CoSec-Identity` header (base64url, no padding) a gateway sets on a permitted request: who the caller is, the scope the gateway decided in and what the caller is a member of. Never a credential, a policy's content or an attribute value. Passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient: the compiler also checks what JSON Schema cannot express, such as unique ids, time zones and expression syntax, so compile or load the document too.

capped.description: `true` for a credential with a role cap (an API key with `roles`): the roles above are capped by it. Absent for every other credential, never `false`.

iat.description: When the credential was issued, a token's iat: never after exp. Absent when the credential does not say.

jti.description: The token or API key id.

method.description: How the principal authenticated: `jwt`, `api-key` and `service` are CoSec's own, `api-key` and `service` a workload's credential, and an authenticator of another credential names its own.

session.description: The session of CoSec's own token (method jwt, with iat), which a tenant switch behind the gateway issues from. Absent for any other credential.

auth_time.description: When the user signed in, by the session's clock.

generation.description: Which generation of the session the token is.

iat.description: When the gateway made the header.

memberships.description: What the principal is a member of besides `roles` (IDN-39), empty when nothing: CoSec's writers write it, but for a relay of an identity forwarded without it, which leaves it out (IDN-42); a host that decides on the identity refuses one without it.

attachments.description: The ids of the policies the principal attaches, in the order its memberships name them.

spaces.description: The roles in each other space, by space id (empty for the default space). Never the scope's own space, whose roles are `roles`; never `*`.

roles.description: The roles effective in that scope after membership resolution.

scope.description: The scope the gateway decided in, resolved; empty strings for no app and the default space.

title: CoSec Identity Schema
